warning: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA. Every value in this file was generated by a random number generator in tools/make_synthetic_demo.py. No model produced any of it, no manuscript was examined, and nothing here is a measurement. It exists so that the analysis code can be demonstrated and tested. Do not cite it, do not compare it with the study's published results, and do not treat any quantity computed from it as a finding.
what_this_is: A fabricated table in the shape of a four-rung E0/E1 fair-scoring cell table. One row is one (system, rung, relation).
not_experimental_evidence: The study's measured outcomes are not published in this repository. See README.md, section 'What this repository does and does not contain'.

rungs.label: Blind finding list
rungs.exposure: Nothing is pointed at. The system sees the whole manuscript and is asked what, if anything, is wrong with it.
rungs.response_interface: Ranked list of findings, each with a described defect and cited lines.

rungs.label: Category-targeted finding list
rungs.exposure: The system is told which FAMILY of defect to look for, but not where or which relation.
rungs.response_interface: Ranked list of findings, each with a described defect and cited lines.

rungs.label: Relation-targeted finding list
rungs.exposure: The system is told the exact relation under test, in words, and asked to report what it finds.
rungs.response_interface: Ranked list of findings, each with a described defect and cited lines.

rungs.label: Relation-localized binary verdict
rungs.exposure: The same exact relation as the rung above. The information is identical; only the response interface changes.
rungs.response_interface: A binary verdict on the named relation, with cited evidence lines.
